_meta.note: Cohort-fallback LIFECYCLE & OPERATIONS (round 4) — the data-lifecycle/legal, identity/jurisdiction, interoperability and reliability/ML-ops safeguards that take the model from spec to operable. Three locked decisions (below); the data-erasure mechanism is HELD as an open TODO. Builds on the progressive-data / cohort-governance / degradation-integrity trilogy. Illustrative; re-verify (README §5.6).

decisions.k: Cohort reference — opt-in ancestry, clinical default
decisions.v: Ethnicity is NEVER inferred (special-category data). The default reference is a transparent UAE-resident / clinical-standard cohort; a user may self-declare an ancestry reference to use, recorded in provenance and toggleable. Selectable references: Emirati/Gulf Arab · South Asian · other Arab · Filipino/SE-Asian · Sub-Saharan African · Iranian · Western (default = UAE-resident/clinical-standard).

Every degradation/safety registry (λ, k-anon threshold, the invariants) is versioned + content-hashed; changes go shadow-eval (old vs new on live traffic, diff score deltas + invariant-violation counts) → percentage canary → auto-rollback on an invariant-violation / score-delta SLO breach; two-person review with a 'safety-invariant change' label; immutable policy-change audit log.

Age-banded pediatric cohorts (or an explicit 'no pediatric cohort' label where none exists), verified guardian consent with audit, and an age-of-majority workflow that forces re-consent, hands ownership to the now-adult, and revokes guardian access.

rows.v: HELD — open decision. Candidate: per-user crypto-shredding + a hash-preserving tombstone so the immutable ledger still verifies, vs hard delete vs retain-audit-only. To reconcile PDPL/GDPR erasure with the immutable provenance ledger. REVISIT before any production handling of deletion.

A deleted user's real measurements are baked into cohort medians; erasure schedules a deferred, k-anonymous rebuild of the affected cohort cells; superseded versions are frozen-and-quarantined (not servable) under legal-hold, with a deletion-propagation receipt.

An erasure manifest enumerates every derived artifact keyed to the user (personal baselines, reservoir state, score history, forecast cones, ledger entries) so deletion cascades across all of them, with a completion certificate.

Differentiated, automated TTLs: raw device signals rolling N-months; provenance/audit records kept under SaMD obligation but pseudonymised after account closure; cohort versions aged-out on schedule — balancing storage-limitation against medical-device audit duties.

A documented backup-retention ceiling + a suppression list so a restored backup re-applies pending erasures before reactivation; crypto-shredding makes backups unreadable without rewriting immutable snapshots.

When no cohort exists and a literature value is used, the provenance ledger carries a structured citation (source, version/year, population, licence/usage terms), surfaced in the estimate explanation and versioned so stale references are flagged.

DECISION — never infer ethnicity; default to a transparent UAE-resident/clinical reference; user may self-declare an ancestry reference, recorded in provenance and toggleable. Selectable references: Emirati/Gulf Arab · South Asian · other Arab · Filipino/SE-Asian · Sub-Saharan African · Iranian · Western (default = UAE-resident/clinical-standard).

Residency changes are detected via explicit user attestation (not geolocation alone); data-residency is pinned to the controlling jurisdiction with a documented transfer mechanism; any cohort-reference change is annotated in the timeline as an administrative (non-clinical) discontinuity.
DECISION — age-banded pediatric cohorts (or out-of-scope label), verified guardian consent with audit, and a majority-transition workflow (re-consent, ownership handover, guardian-access revocation).

A degraded/cohort-filled value maps to FHIR Observation.status (not 'final'), DataAbsentReason / derivation extensions and a Provenance resource; the system refuses to emit a degraded value as a plain final Observation, so the estimate flag survives the EHR boundary.

Every score is tagged with its degradation level; imputed values are default-excluded (or weighted/flagged) from research/analytics extracts, which require a separate lawful basis — so imputation bias doesn't contaminate population analytics.

Reference parameters are blended across age-band boundaries (or a continuous-age reference is used); band transitions are annotated as administrative and trend-continuity is verified in tests, so a user doesn't see a phantom score step on a birthday.

Golden-signal SLIs: degraded-score ratio, per-metric cohort-fill rate, p50/p95 reported Accuracy, an invariant-violation counter (target 0 → hard page), and rolling forecast-cone coverage; a degradation dashboard + burn-rate alerts.

A continuous backtest joins finalized real values against the cone/Accuracy claimed at scoring time (PIT histograms / empirical coverage per metric & cohort), alerts on miscalibration, and feeds recalibration back into the Accuracy formula — an over-narrow cone is a safety bug, not a UX nicety.

A circuit breaker around cohort lookups with a per-cohort signed last-known-good cache (staleness-bounded); if both live and cached are unavailable the deterministic safe terminal state SUPPRESSES the score ('temporarily unavailable') and NEVER fabricates a median — tested with fault injection.

Pinned cohort snapshots are content-addressed and WORM-retained for the full audit window; hash-verified on read; autophagy/GC is blocked for any version still referenced by a retained score; dangling references alarm.

Property-based / metamorphic tests inject synthetic missing-then-present data across the value space and assert the invariants end-to-end ('imputing a high-stakes value never raises the score', 'a real-critical always breaks the freeze'), plus a held-out backtest and a golden-score regression suite in CI + pre-rollout shadow — the build guards check structure, these check behaviour.

Defined precompute-vs-on-demand split (hot cache of medians + conditional-model artifacts), per-tenant/global cost ceilings with budget alarms, recompute-storm rate-limiting, and an explicit p99 latency budget for cohort-lookup + impute with a deterministic cheaper fallback on timeout (emitted as a tracked event).

The conditional/multivariate imputer carries a model card (training population, features, subgroup performance), a subgroup error/coverage parity eval as a release gate, and a drift-triggered retraining cadence.
A plain-language imputation lineage ('we estimated your LDL from your ApoB and HbA1c') is surfaced in the UI and the audit ledger, so an inferred value can be understood and contested.

DECISION — registries versioned + content-hashed; shadow → canary → auto-rollback on invariant-violation/score-delta SLO breach; two-person 'safety-invariant change' review; immutable policy-change audit log.

Non-visual equivalents for 'estimated vs measured', cone width and Accuracy%: aria-labels ('estimated value, accuracy 72%, likely range A–B'), non-colour encoding (icon/pattern + label), an accessible textual cone description, and a11y regression tests — a low-vision user must never act on a cohort median as if measured.

Degrade-entered and recovery notices route through the same governance as nudges: a priority tier below real-critical, quiet-hours respect (unless safety-critical), debounce/hysteresis to prevent 3am flapping, and a bounded budget in the nudge auction with explicit precedence.
